question: Among members who attended the 'Yearly Kickoff' event and are from the 'Art and Design Department', what percentage of their associated income records are exactly $50?

prediction.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN i.XCL_026 = 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(i.XCL_024) AS percentage
FROM income AS i
JOIN member AS m ON i.XCL_029 = m.XCL_034
JOIN major AS mj ON m.XCL_042 = mj.XCL_030
JOIN attendance AS a ON m.XCL_034 = a.XCL_002
JOIN event AS e ON a.XCL_001 = e.XCL_010
WHERE e.XCL_011 = 'Yearly Kickoff'
  AND mj.XCL_032 = 'Art and Design Department'
